notes: לְעֻמָּתָם is fused into *beside* with the clause's copula joining it, under rule 30's clause about a unit that additionally carries a construction-supplied word (cf. לִפְנֵי → *was before*).
מִלְמָעְלָה is one fusion unit rather than a chain of `unrepresented` particles, since the single English *above* carries every morpheme's sense.
*the glory of the God of Israel* has no article morpheme anywhere in the chain, so both written *the*s are supplied ones placed by rule 29's multi-level clause.
